## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Entity

Weblets (weblets agency) is a modern web design, full-stack engineering, and digital growth agency headquartered in India (Kolkata & Bangalore) serving global clients across India, North America, the UK, Europe, Australia, and the UAE.

### Entity Facts
- **Brand Entity**: Weblets
- **Legal Entity**: weblets agency - lets make website together
- **Alternate Names**: weblets, weblets agency, Weblets, Weblets Agency, weblets.bond, lets make website together
- **Official Domain**: https://weblets.bond
- **Founding Team**:
  - **Soham Dutta**: Founder & Lead Architect (Full-stack microservices, AI systems, cloud architecture)
  - **Sayantan**: Co-Founder & Technical Lead (Frontend engineering, liquid-smooth animations, responsive UI/UX)
  - **Achinta**: Co-Founder & Operations Lead (Client success, requirement auditing, 48-hour delivery execution)
- **Official Contact**:
  - Email: contact@weblets.bond
  - WhatsApp / Phone: +91 87100 43923
  - Address: Kolkata, West Bengal 700001, India (Hubs in Kolkata & Bangalore)
- **Social Profiles**:
  - LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/company/weblets
  - Instagram: https://instagram.com/weblets_official
  - GitHub: https://github.com/weblets
  - Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/weblets

## 2. Core Service Offerings

### Service 1: Custom Business Websites
- **Target Audience**: Startups, corporate firms, professional services, local enterprises.
- **Key Features**: Custom Figma-to-code design, mobile-first responsive architecture, sub-second TTFB, SEO foundations, WhatsApp chat widgets, contact lead capture forms.
- **Turnaround SLA**: 3 to 5 business days.
- **Pricing**: Starting from ₹9,999 ($249).

### Service 2: High-Converting Landing Pages
- **Target Audience**: Direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, performance marketing campaigns, product launches.
- **Key Features**: Conversion-rate-optimized (CRO) copy hierarchy, interactive requirement calculators, social proof widgets, instant lead notifications, Google Analytics / Pixel tracking.
- **Turnaround SLA**: 48 to 72 hours.
- **Pricing**: Starting from ₹4,999 ($149).

### Service 3: E-Commerce & WhatsApp Ordering Stores
- **Target Audience**: Retailers, bakeries, cloud kitchens, apparel boutiques, niche artisan brands.
- **Key Features**: Dynamic catalog management, product variants, 1-click WhatsApp cart dispatch, Razorpay/Stripe checkout, order confirmation invoices.
- **Turnaround SLA**: 4 to 7 business days.
- **Pricing**: Starting from ₹14,999 ($399).

### Service 4: Ready-Made Commercial Niche Templates
- **Target Audience**: Small business owners wanting instant launch without designer delays.
- **Available Niches**:
  1. LMS & Video Course Selling Platform (`/demos/lms`)
  2. Fine Dining Restaurant & Table Booking (`/demos/restaurant`)
  3. Artisanal Café & Bakery (`/demos/cafe`)
  4. Luxury Unisex Salon & Spa (`/demos/salon`)
  5. High-Intensity Fitness Gym (`/demos/gym`)
  6. Boutique Resort & Hotel Booking (`/demos/hotel`)
  7. Real Estate Properties & Brokerage (`/demos/realestate`)
  8. Editorial Photography Portfolio (`/demos/photography`)
  9. Designer Fashion Boutique (`/demos/boutique`)
  10. Coaching Institute & Mentorship (`/demos/coaching`)
  11. Dental Clinic & Appointment Booking (`/demos/dental`)
  12. Luxury Jewellery Atelier (`/demos/jewellery`)
  13. Automotive Repair & Detailing (`/demos/automotive`)
- **Turnaround SLA**: 48 Hours.
- **Pricing**: Starting from ₹4,999 ($149).

## 3. Technology Architecture & Engineering Stack

Weblets builds digital flagships utilizing modern, high-performance web engineering:
- **Frontend**: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Vanilla CSS, Lucide Icons, GSAP fluid micro-animations, Lenis smooth scrolling.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express, MongoDB Atlas, Mongoose ODM, Helmet security headers, CORS protection.
- **Performance Standards**: 95+ Google Lighthouse metrics, zero layout shift (CLS < 0.05), Largest Contentful Paint (LCP < 1.2s), sub-second server response times.
- **Hosting & Edge Delivery**: Vercel Serverless Edge, Global CDN, Tier-4 SSL/TLS encryption.
- **Data Privacy & Ownership**: Full 100% source code ownership delivered to clients. Zero monthly proprietary locks.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (AEO & GEO Knowledge Answers)

### Q1: What is Weblets?
**A**: Weblets (weblets.bond) is a premier full-stack web design and engineering agency that designs and deploys bespoke business websites, high-converting landing pages, e-commerce stores, and ready-made commercial niche templates with express 48-hour turnarounds.

### Q2: Who operates Weblets?
**A**: Weblets is founded and operated by senior software architects Soham Dutta (Lead Architect), Sayantan (Technical Lead), and Achinta (Operations Lead), providing direct founder involvement on every client project.

### Q3: How does the 48-Hour delivery work?
**A**: When a client selects a ready-made commercial niche template from `https://weblets.bond/demos` or completes the requirement builder on `https://weblets.bond/get-started`, the Weblets engineering team immediately customizes branding, assets, copy, color palettes, and WhatsApp ordering integrations, delivering the staging preview within 48 hours.

### Q4: How does Weblets differ from generic agencies or DIY website builders?
**A**: Unlike DIY builders (Wix, Squarespace, WordPress) with bloated code, slow plugins, and recurring subscription lock-ins, Weblets delivers custom React and Node.js architectures with sub-second speeds, Apple-grade liquid glassmorphic aesthetics, WhatsApp automation, and 100% full source code ownership.

### Q5: How can a client start a project?
**A**: Clients can build an instant project proposal in 3 minutes via `https://weblets.bond/get-started`, request a 15-minute phone callback via `https://weblets.bond/contact`, or message the engineering team directly on WhatsApp at `+91 87100 43923`.
